name: Burj Khalifa
description: A fully recreated Burj Khalifa in Space Station 13 with all 163 floors (154 + 9 Z levels). This map includes the tower's distinctive Y-shaped floor plan, tapering design, and various functional areas including offices, residential spaces, restaurants, an observatory, and swimming pools.
